task: Predict EGFR mutation status in lung adenocarcinoma. Classes: wildtype vs. mutant. On H&E, look for adenocarcinoma growth patterns that differ between groups, especially lepidic or papillary architecture, mucin production, nuclear atypia, and solid growth.

classes.0: EGFR wildtype lung adenocarcinoma with relatively more non-lepidic, higher-grade, or solid architectural patterns.
classes.1: EGFR mutant lung adenocarcinoma with features often enriched in this group, including lepidic or papillary growth, more delicate gland formation, and less overtly high-grade morphology.
